calibration.quantity: volume-equivalent diameter of this mesh with its three extents fitted to the published 2.1 × 1 × 1 km
calibration.notes: The mesh's longest extent across the spin axis, the extent at right angles to it and the extent along the spin axis are 2.1533, 1.1070, 1.0620 source units. One scale fitted to 2.1, 1, 1 km by least squares is 0.9572 km per unit; each extent alone gives 0.975, 0.903, 0.942 km per unit, and half that range is the quoted uncertainty. The published dimensions carry no error bars.
